completeness.why: getNextDate passes its raw skipWeekend and weekendSolve to applyWeekendRule (its noSkipWeekend guard is a variation only that site has) and getUpcomingDates passes skipWeekend/weekendSolveMode directly; both schedule-template sites call applyWeekendRule but keep their own outer `skipWeekend ? ... : nextBaseDate` ternary, so whether the rule applies is still decided there too.

interface.why: applyWeekendRule(date, skipWeekend, solveMode) takes exactly the real variation with each caller mapping its own field name and no speculative options; getDateWithSkippedWeekend stays exported and there is no day-string variant, so template callers still convert and can bypass the enable flag.

disguised_duplication.where: The leftover skipWeekend checks in server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList are plain redundant guards around applyWeekendRule, not a reshaped copy.
